evals.prompt: Using the Agentic V-Method, add a CSV export button to the reports page of our Express + React app. The export includes customer names and order totals for the currently filtered rows.
evals.expected_output: Routes the work through PL sizing, proposes the Standard route, and drives AN toward a SPEC before any code
expectations: Output checks the repository for existing method artifacts or conventions before creating new ones
Output asks at most three sizing questions (scope, risk, reversibility) or infers them, and proposes a route with justification
Output identifies the sensitive-data and CSV-injection risk and recommends at least the Standard route
Output does not write production code before a SPEC with numbered acceptance criteria is approved (Gate 1)
Output shows the stage progress (PL, AN, DE, BU, TE, DP) and names the next skill to invoke

evals.prompt: Continue the payments refactor. The folder docs/v-method/2026-11-02-payments-refactor has SPEC.md (revision 2, approved), PLAN.md with tasks T1-T8, and GATES.md showing Gate 1 and Gate 2 approved. Git log shows commits for T1 through T5.
evals.expected_output: Detects state from artifacts and resumes the Build stage at T6 after confirming with the user
expectations: Output reads or references the existing artifacts instead of restarting planning
Output determines the current stage is BU and the next task is T6
Output asks the user to confirm before resuming
Output names executing-plans (and test-driven-development) as the skills for the next step
Output does not re-run Gate 1 or Gate 2 without a reason

evals.prompt: We approved the SPEC for the export feature yesterday and started building. Now product says the export must also support Excel. Just add it to the current task, it's small.
evals.expected_output: Applies the change protocol instead of silently expanding scope
expectations: Output declines to silently add the requirement to the current task
Output performs or outlines an impact analysis (new acceptance criterion, tasks, tests, rollback)
Output proposes a new SPEC revision and re-approval of Gate 1 (and Gate 2 if the plan changes)
Output records or proposes recording the decision in GATES.md
Output keeps the explanation short and offers to proceed once approved
